# Motopedia

> Motopedia is a free, open motorcycle encyclopedia and course by Transitions Lab: how motorcycles work (petrol and electric), how to diagnose faults, repair them and find spare parts, with interactive 3D tools. Text and figures are CC BY-SA 4.0.

Why it exists: hundreds of millions of people depend on motorcycles, the mechanics who keep them running mostly learn on the job, and electric motorcycles need skills almost nobody has been trained in. Motopedia is free, open training for them: understand how it works, see it in 3D, then find and fix the fault.

Written in plain English for riders, mechanics, trainers and fleet operators. Reference values come from a fuel-injected 125 cc single (the K-Light 125); always check your own bike's manual.

## Course

- [Course overview](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/): six modules with live figures and a check at the end of every chapter
- [Crash course](https://www.motopedia.org/crash-course/): the whole motorcycle in 15 minutes
- [Module 1: Foundations: the machine, its anatomy and the workshop](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/#foundations)
- [Module 2: The engine: four-stroke and two-stroke](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/#engine)
- [Module 3: Fuel, air and exhaust](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/#fuel)
- [Module 4: Electrical systems: ignition, battery, charging and lighting](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/#electrics)
- [Module 5: Drivetrain and chassis](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/#drivetrain-chassis)
- [Module 6: Electric motorcycles](https://www.motopedia.org/learn/#electric)
- [Quiz](https://www.motopedia.org/quiz/): questions for every module

## Repair

- [Repair home](https://www.motopedia.org/repair/): search any problem, part or job
- [Diagnose a problem](https://www.motopedia.org/repair/diagnose/): three questions to the likely fault
- [Problems by symptom](https://www.motopedia.org/repair/problems/): step-by-step checks
- [Repairs](https://www.motopedia.org/repair/repairs/): jobs from rider level to workshop
- [Parts](https://www.motopedia.org/repair/parts/): what each part does and how it fails
- [Repairs by bike](https://www.motopedia.org/repair/bikes/): 500 motorcycles and scooters with specs, top repairs and problems

## Spare parts

- [Spare parts](https://www.motopedia.org/parts/): what wears, replacement intervals, typical prices and where to buy, per model

## Tools

- [3D Overview](https://www.motopedia.org/overview/): interactive motorcycle parts diagram
- [Cockpit](https://www.motopedia.org/cockpit/): ride the bike, start it, run the dyno
- [Under the Engine](https://www.motopedia.org/engine/): 3D 125 cc engine, gearbox and clutch
- [Wiring Lab](https://www.motopedia.org/wiring/): harness, starting, charging and ignition circuits
- [Bike builder](https://www.motopedia.org/build/): assemble a bike and change its specification
- [Motorcycle types](https://www.motopedia.org/types/) and [History](https://www.motopedia.org/history/)
